Reviewed relay constructor and call context: captures owned Rust endpoint/string before allow_threads, does not access Python without GIL, preserves errors via to_pyerr and shutdown ownership. Prevents Rust initialization from blocking metrics callbacks that require GIL. Does not certify TRT direct publisher path.

Wrapper and Arc delegate device_identity to the underlying allocation; legacy CUDA-only registration explicitly returns ownership of non-CUDA storage as Err instead of misregistering its pointer. Actual Ascend PD uses vendor Mooncake, not this NIXL path. No new allocation lifetime or lock.
MetaX socket naming uses provider UUID; other branches retain upstream behavior. Initialization remains before UUID cache insertion, so failure cannot cache a fabricated identity.

Explicit platform selection and MACA detection precede CUDA-compatible APIs. Singleton publishes state only after provider construction succeeds under lock. Ascend is deliberately unimplemented; historical CANN9.1 error text is not evidence about CANN9.2.1. CUDA/MetaX hardware validation remains deferred.
Default access_requires_remap=False preserves CUDA/XPU behavior; provider can opt into remapping for read-only protection. No new mandatory abstract method.
Current target implementation retained except attribution; original fork edits were superseded by the target worker implementation. Does not claim Ascend GMS hardware support.
